pattern: であれ / であろうと
purpose: Assert that a condition does not change the main judgment.
keywords: N / な-adjective stem + であれ / であろうと
Even beginners must follow the rules.
No one may enter without permission, whoever they are.
Even if it is inconvenient, I want to preserve this house.
formation: N / な-adjective stem + であれ / であろうと
restrictions: Often includes たとえ or a question word.
mistake: For verbs use a suitable ようと form, not dictionary + であれ.
